quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI project management tool that predicts which tasks will miss deadlines two weeks in advance.
quests.correctAnswer: Two weeks before a deadline slips, the system flags it and tells you why - giving your team time to actually fix the problem, not just explain it.
quests.hint: Lead with the two-week actionable warning window.
quests.explanation: Two weeks of advance warning is genuinely actionable, unlike the day-before alerts most project tools generate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a no-code automation builder that non-technical teams can use without engineering support.
quests.correctAnswer: Marketing and finance teams automate their own workflows in an afternoon, without writing code or filing a single ticket with IT.
quests.hint: Emphasise deployment speed without engineering dependency.
quests.explanation: Removing the engineering bottleneck directly empowers business teams and speeds up everyday work.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family budgeting app that shows two partners a shared view of spending without either feeling watched.
quests.correctAnswer: Both partners see the shared picture - bills, savings, goals - without either feeling like their morning coffee is under review.
quests.hint: Balance transparency with respecting personal privacy.
quests.explanation: Solving money conversations without creating surveillance is a genuinely delicate, and genuinely valued, balance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an asynchronous video tool that replaces unnecessary meetings with short recorded updates.
quests.correctAnswer: Share a complex update on video whenever it suits you, and let your team watch it whenever suits them - no meeting required.
quests.hint: Open with the meeting-replacement value.
quests.explanation: Meeting reduction is a near-universal workplace wish, and async video keeps the clarity while dropping the schedule.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family travel app that automatically finds activities suitable for every generation on the same trip.
quests.correctAnswer: It suggests one afternoon that actually works for a toddler, a teenager, and a grandparent - no more three separate arguments about what to do next.
quests.hint: Name the classic multi-generation trip conflict directly.
quests.explanation: Naming a very specific, relatable family conflict makes an ordinary planning app feel worth the download.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a crisis communication platform that sends one coordinated message across every company channel at once.
quests.correctAnswer: One message goes out everywhere at once, so every employee and customer hears the same thing within seconds of any incident.
quests.hint: Start with the simultaneous multi-channel coordination.
quests.explanation: Consistent messaging across channels prevents the confusion that turns a small incident into a bigger one.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI CV screening tool that removes unconscious bias from the shortlisting process.
quests.correctAnswer: It shortlists on skills and potential alone, not names or schools, so hiring decisions are judged on merit and nothing else.
quests.hint: Begin with the bias removal mechanism directly.
quests.explanation: Bias-free shortlisting speaks to both the ethical case and the practical business case for diverse hiring.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a hotel loyalty app that lets guests redeem points at partner restaurants and shops in the same city.
quests.correctAnswer: Points earned on a hotel stay now buy dinner down the street too, so a single trip rewards you in more places than just the room.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in points working beyond just the hotel itself.
quests.explanation: Extending value beyond the original purchase makes a loyalty programme feel far more generous and useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an employee experience platform that predicts turnover risk six months before someone resigns.
quests.correctAnswer: It flags a flight risk six months out, giving a manager real time to fix the problem before losing someone genuinely valuable.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the six-month early warning.
quests.explanation: Six months is enough time to act meaningfully, which is what makes this a retention tool rather than a report.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wedding planning app that keeps two families' guest lists, budgets, and preferences in one shared plan.
quests.correctAnswer: Both families see the same budget and guest list in real time, so nobody finds out about a change from a group chat.
quests.hint: Focus on avoiding the awkward surprise, not just organisation.
quests.explanation: Preventing an awkward surprise between families addresses the real emotional risk behind wedding planning, not just the logistics.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that sends a themed craft project for kids matched to their current age and skill.
quests.correctAnswer: Every box matches your child's current age and skill exactly, so it's always challenging enough to be fun, never frustrating.
quests.hint: Focus on the right level of challenge, not just the craft itself.
quests.explanation: Keeping a child in the right challenge zone is what keeps a craft box exciting month after month.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace coaching app that gives new managers real-time tips during their very first team meetings.
quests.correctAnswer: A quiet prompt reminds a brand-new manager to ask, not just tell, right in the middle of their very first real team meeting.
quests.hint: Picture the exact nervous first meeting this helps with.
quests.explanation: A specific, nerve-wracking first moment makes a coaching app feel like real support, not just another training video.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personal styling app that builds outfits from clothes you already own for any occasion.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell it the occasion, and it builds three outfit options from your own wardrobe, before you ever think about buying something new.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in using what's already owned, not new shopping.
quests.explanation: Solving the 'nothing to wear' feeling with clothes already owned feels smarter than suggesting another purchase.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace mentoring platform that matches junior employees with senior staff based on actual career goals.
quests.correctAnswer: It matches junior staff with a senior mentor based on where they actually want their career to go, not just who happens to be free.
quests.hint: Lead with goal-based matching over convenience matching.
quests.explanation: Matching by genuine goals, not availability, is what makes a mentoring programme feel worth showing up to.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel app that automatically finds the best value flight and hotel combination within a set budget.
quests.correctAnswer: Set one total budget, and it finds the flight-and-hotel combination that stretches it furthest - no more juggling five separate browser tabs.
quests.hint: Focus on the tab-juggling this replaces.
quests.explanation: Naming the specific frustrating habit - tab juggling - makes a routine travel tool feel like real relief.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a customer support platform that answers routine questions instantly while routing complex ones to a real person.
quests.correctAnswer: Simple questions get an instant answer, and anything genuinely complicated goes straight to a real person - no dead-end chatbot loops.
quests.hint: Open with what it hands off, not just what it automates.
quests.explanation: Knowing when to hand off to a human is what separates a helpful support tool from a frustrating one.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a school app that lets teachers send a single weekly update instead of constant individual messages to parents.
quests.correctAnswer: One clear update a week replaces a dozen scattered messages, so parents stay informed and teachers get their evenings back.
quests.hint: Balance the benefit for both teachers and parents.
quests.explanation: Solving a problem for both sides of a relationship, not just one, is what makes adoption easy.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that delivers a themed cocktail or mocktail kit for hosting friends at home.
quests.correctAnswer: Every ingredient and the exact recipe arrive together, so hosting friends feels like a bar night without ever leaving the kitchen.
quests.hint: Start with the finished experience, not just the ingredients.
quests.explanation: Selling the finished evening, not just the ingredients, makes a simple kit feel like an occasion worth having.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fleet management platform that reduces fuel costs by finding the most efficient delivery routes automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: It quietly reroutes every driver onto the most efficient path each morning, trimming fuel costs without anyone having to think about it.
quests.hint: Begin with the effortless, automatic optimisation.
quests.explanation: Savings that require zero extra effort from a busy operations team are the easiest kind to sell.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends age-appropriate books matched precisely to a child's current reading level.
quests.correctAnswer: Each book is matched to exactly where your child is right now, so reading always feels like an achievement, never a struggle.
quests.hint: Focus on the right level of challenge, not just book variety.
quests.explanation: Matching precisely to a child's level keeps reading feeling rewarding instead of frustrating.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an expense management app that automatically sorts receipts by category the moment you photograph them.
quests.correctAnswer: Snap a photo of the receipt, and it's already filed under the right category - no spreadsheet, no end-of-month scramble.
quests.hint: Focus on the moment of relief, not the filing system.
quests.explanation: Removing the dreaded end-of-month scramble is a specific, relatable relief for anyone who has ever done expenses.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace app that matches employees to internal projects based on their actual skills, not their job title.
quests.correctAnswer: It looks past job titles to actual skills, so the right internal person is matched to a new project, even if their day job has nothing to do with it.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in skills over titles as the key distinction.
quests.explanation: Looking past job titles is what actually uncovers hidden talent a company already has, without hiring anyone new.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family reunion planning app that manages RSVPs, dietary needs, and accommodation across dozens of relatives.
quests.correctAnswer: Every RSVP, dietary note, and hotel booking lives in one place, so planning for forty relatives finally feels manageable, not chaotic.
quests.hint: Name the scale of the chaos it replaces.
quests.explanation: Naming the scale of the problem - dozens of relatives - makes the promised order feel genuinely valuable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an onboarding platform that gets a new employee fully productive in their first week instead of their first month.
quests.correctAnswer: New hires know exactly what to do from day one, so the usual month of finding their feet shrinks down to a single week.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on the specific time compression, week versus month.
quests.explanation: A specific time comparison, week versus month, makes an abstract onboarding improvement feel concrete and measurable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personal shopping app that alerts you the instant an item on your wishlist drops in price.
quests.correctAnswer: The second that jacket on your wishlist drops in price, you know first - before the sale even reaches the homepage.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in speed and being first to know.
quests.explanation: Being first to know creates urgency and makes an ordinary price tracker feel genuinely exciting to use.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace scheduling tool that fairly rotates unpopular shifts so the same people aren't always stuck with them.
quests.correctAnswer: It rotates the early mornings and late nights fairly, so the same three people don't quietly end up with every bad shift.
quests.hint: Name the specific unfairness this solves.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific, recognisable unfairness makes a scheduling tool feel like it genuinely cares about the team.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel app that reroutes your itinerary automatically the moment a flight or event is cancelled.
quests.correctAnswer: The moment a flight is cancelled, a new plan is already waiting - so a single disruption never unravels the whole trip.
quests.hint: Highlight the instant, automatic replanning.
quests.explanation: Automatic replanning solves the single most stressful part of travel: watching one problem become several.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace platform that turns scattered feedback from 360 reviews into three clear development priorities.
quests.correctAnswer: Instead of twenty scattered comments, an employee gets three clear priorities to actually work on this quarter.
quests.hint: Contrast overwhelming feedback with a short, focused list.
quests.explanation: Turning overwhelming feedback into a short, focused list is what actually makes people act on it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that plans a themed movie night by matching a film to everyone's mood and age range.
quests.correctAnswer: It picks one film that suits every age and every mood in the room, ending the usual twenty-minute scroll through the streaming menu.
quests.hint: Name the scrolling stalemate this solves.
quests.explanation: Naming the exact modern frustration - endless scrolling - makes a simple recommendation feel like real relief.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a retail analytics platform that tells small shop owners which products to reorder before they sell out.
quests.correctAnswer: It tells a small shop owner exactly what to reorder, and when, so a bestseller never sits empty on the shelf for a week.
quests.hint: Focus on the lost sale this prevents.
quests.explanation: Preventing a specific, believable lost sale is more persuasive to a small business owner than general 'insights.'
